name: TC-19-vendor-performance
description: TC-19.1: Vendor Performance — View vendor metrics and delivery rating calculations

doc_metadata.title: TC-19.1 — Vendor List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Vendor. Vendor performance metrics are automatically calculated from purchase receipt delivery data.

doc_metadata.title: TC-19.1 — Vendor Performance Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The vendor list shows all vendors with their delivery rating, on-time deliveries, late deliveries, quality score, and total orders processed.

doc_metadata.title: TC-19.1 — New Vendor
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a vendor. Enter vendor name, contact details, and payment terms. Performance metrics will be calculated automatically as purchase receipts are recorded.

doc_metadata.title: TC-19.1 — Fill Vendor Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Performance Test Vendor" into the Vendor Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-19.1 — Vendor Created
doc_metadata.caption: The vendor is created with initial performance metrics at zero. As PO receipts are processed, delivery_rating, on_time_deliveries, late_deliveries, and quality_rating are updated automatically.

doc_metadata.title: TC-19.1 — Vendor Detail & Metrics
doc_metadata.caption: The vendor detail page shows contact information, payment terms, and the performance metrics section with delivery rating formula: on_time_deliveries / total_orders × 100.
